h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Danapur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Danapur

c: Danapur lies just west of Patna along the Ganga and is home to one of the oldest army cantonments in the country. Around it, new apartment blocks and colonies have grown along the road into Patna. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Danapur to cantonment and government campuses, schools, colleges, apartment societies and colony parks. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, about 1,430 km away, and sent by road.

Apartment societies and cantonment campuses ask for quite different things. A society wants a compact gym in its common area that residents of every age can use. A cantonment or police campus wants solid strength stations that a group can work through together. Both need to handle a hot summer and a heavy monsoon, so we use galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts, and we grout machines into concrete on open ground.

items.q: Can you supply an outdoor gym for a cantonment or police campus?
items.a: Yes. Send us the area, photos and the number of people likely to train at once. We will propose machines with a layout drawing and a quote for approval.

items.q: What suits an apartment society in Danapur?
items.a: A compact set of three or four machines, such as an air walker, a twister and a chest press, placed in the common area. We draw the layout to fit your space.

items.q: Do you deliver to the Patna area?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai, and our team or a dealer covering eastern India installs the machines at your site in Danapur or Patna.
